contract.meaning: Empty root, bridge docstring only; compatibility package prepends resolved directory only if absent then exposes Blue API. Bridge independently conditionally prepends pipeline directory before flat imports, and path-based loader inserts module before executing it. Existing sys.path entry retains position; actual import environment and configured loader paths are conditional.

Split caller-order runs when either boundary decreases; strict start and inclusive end; bisect returns enclosing payloads in run/input order. Exact datetime type, naive and nondecreasing eligibility including empty sequence; no fallback supplied by helper.

Retain Decimal instance else Decimal(str(value)); cannot restore precision already lost upstream. First/Break converted int pair is physical identity, not a chronology or ownership proof; bridge strict stop proof, audit dedup and required order identities use these primitives without rounding.

Policy selector rejects directions outside exact bullish/bearish; stored field drives strict low/high extreme and confirmation reverse comparison. T/F repair selects first_less/first_greater and verdict normalization uses copy_negate only for lower-extreme direction. Native consumer decisions remain in owner review.

Prepared index registered only when its candles object is identical; indexed segment wrapper exposes exact slice times, clamps first-cross bounds and translates coordinates, range-extreme validates bounds. Nested window flattens base offset. No assumption that prepared index is a concrete LowerTimeframeIndex; native accepts protocol by identity.

Strict first-cross search excludes equality; range extrema earliest equal position; crossing cache retains settled rows only, excludes final mutable candle from remembered proof. Chronology bisects [start,end), main_index right-bisects and clamps only lower underflow if requested; native confirmation falls back to Break open, bridge verifies exact recorded timestamp separately.

Opposite containment requires strict first time, inclusive confirmation and geometric containment; complete lower path extrema required. Indexed containment only for exact naive datetime; otherwise scan; annotations use original objects and stable physical identities. Bridge live route delegates ownership, batch route selects third result.

Committed seed requires >=2 main candles and strict incremental grids; preview copies snapshot and does not commit. Empty paired extension returns snapshot; live continuation retains unresolved restart frontier; bridge may choose live stage service and isolated market context, runtime feasibility remains conditional.

Native Blue receives full direction reactions and resets plus chronology. Live continuation rewinds first_changed on dirty Break or Reset ownership; exact range checks and retained checkpoint prefix. Bridge freezes first-pass Blue/A/initial S across Order_B feedback, not new geometry.

Public Blue only valid and noninternal. Internal marking uses owner ordinal or strict interior of both semantic and rendered prices; fallback scan when unsafe datetime index. Bridge retains full ordinal map for A linkage even when public Blue list filtered.

A sorts Blue by reaction ordinal/source/kind, preserves original Reaction order; native confirmation starts at Break open (use_intrabar_start false). Ordered eligible bisection or original linear fallback, inclusive trigger/first gate. Bridge uses same false flag for A projection.

Native A outputs sorted by source/trigger; first-stop cycle test rejects recross as a new first stop. Live settlement uses strict dirty boundary and fresh input suffix. A provisional until S eligibility and lifecycle invalidation; presentation-hidden A not automatically invalid. Shared feedback list references and initial S copy retained.

S receives full trend/opposite reactions, resets, native A and Blue, shared chronology and initial_order_geometry. A sort by Break time then source index; inclusive main range, half-open lower range. Native sorted trend rows and original-order eligibility differ; initial S reused across feedback.

A confirmation delegates native chronology; invalid ordinal raises; first A stop starts max(confirmation,range_start), strict lower crossing, main fallback only if no lower rows. Next A confirmation at/before stop excludes candidate. Ownership window starts strict stop, resolved end max(stop,decision+one microsecond). Candidate rejection and display suppression distinct.

Physical Order dedup First/Break, prefer richer stop evidence; exact crossing strictly after confirmation; sort by cross event, confirmation, First/Break. Preserve creation provenance. Bridge passes eligible-A provenance into E and repeats only while Order_B identity changes.

Live dirty index validation; scope direction/timeframe/start/range-start; dependency symmetric difference can advance invalidation earlier. Reuse only settled decision strictly before dirty time and matching key; main-only fallback not settled. Ownership pass still runs.

Dominance ranks priority, number, source time/index, first-equal original input tie. Activation/stop endpoints inclusive. Per-main stop chooses higher rank incl event time. Accepted A excludes invalid source pair; S/E stop delegated, StopAll retained event. Same-source anchors use priority/number/type tie; later source independent. Reset uses precise second time when available else strict lower crossing of half-open main candle; no fabricated fallback.

Sorted tuple identity carries physical and reset pairs, stop/source/anchor provenance and Decimal boundary, not only count. Feedback up to eight, identical identity registers legs, repeated prior identity or exhaustion raises. Register by physical pair, create stop fields only on missing entry, append distinct cause and sort by exact event/reset/strict/physical identity; invalidate carried caches.

Accepted A filter keeps first accepted creating cause plus complete accepted causes; unchanged entry reused when all equal. Prepared audit merges S then E by pair; include in-range First or required identity, merge causes; stop_cross absent invokes detector, present null stays null. Exact parent-stop key assigned earliest confirmation/First/Break rank; preserve other causes. Bridge validates public physical identities and unique cause owner; restoration rebuild preserves previously canonical identities.

Native opposite matches sorted by confirmation, First, Break, ordinal. Optional independent geometry must start at/after gate index and confirm strictly after A stop, map exact physical identity to existing ordinal else zero. Compare independent/native by First then confirmation, strict earlier wins; no invented public Reaction. Bridge chooses live/native finder or configured callable; selected engine paths remain conditional.

Requires exact direction and supplied sequence-priority resolver; S sorted by source time/index, opposite resets native time order. Range end exclusive lower horizon. Main-range index usable only when exact main candle sequence identity and no live continuation; one-second fallback to lower index, else native sparse table. Bridge prepared window supplies local coordinates and exact candle identity. Optional direct geometry delegates configured member or supplied live finder.

Parent stop from decision_event_time, strict directional lower search bounded by range, never infer absent crossing from main-only data. Live cache retains settled event only within current exclusive range, reopens dirty events; extrema earliest equal position and inclusive main interval. Order stop cached separately, present null means no known crossing. Live zone cache key retains geometry/provenance and reuse requires max event/confirmation strictly before dirty.

Independent S roots only from accepted S not occupying dominant E source; root restoration processes source time/index/ordinal heap, excludes newly disowned parent and may regenerate replacement Order. Replace earliest-decision same-parent winner or add distinct root, resolve same-source conflicts and refresh accepted identities. Bridge donors preserve accepted E at occupied sources; restoration and ensure-audit after lifecycle keep canonical physical Orders.

Native reconciliation uses source-index groups, chronological heap and family priority before within-family chronology; active parents gate continuation, stopped families determine numbering; hard reset clears active sequence. Detect clears accepted identities/audit, registers proven Order_B legs, discovers/reconciles/applies consumed S evidence and resolves same-source conflicts then rebuilds audit. Bridge fresh E detector per initial/S-reconciliation/final/shared-order scope and accepted S changes; consumed continuation replacement triggers final audit rebuild. No cross-owner race acceptance asserted.

Dominant S/E owner increments count for exact kind/family/number; higher priority or E dominance on equal priority replaces. Armed stop needs exact strict event. A donor may prove event in its main source candle with strict price penetration and decision not before stop, or exact matching parent provenance. StopAll boundary frozen by native single-pass detection over accepted E/S, publishes sequence reset map but does not retroactively rebuild E. Bridge passes accepted E and unoccupied independent donors, then restores roots.

Live StopAll dirty frontier bounded by prior covered lower timestamp plus one microsecond. Rewind first changed event repr or source/decision at/after dirty; retain prefix checkpoints and earlier proven stop, re-resolve other stops. Configured finder optional; current live implementation conditional.

Filter creating A causes via accepted sources, union inherited and invalid-pending-A blocks, then subtract accepted First times. E-only exception exact stop/First pair requires accepted E stop, same stop candle, blocked First not inherited, A source<=First<stop and strict later confirmation. Module priority StopAll5, E red4, S red3, E other2, S other1, else0. Explicit stop_event_time wins before callback; tuple returns last field.

Map exact stop to containing main candle via bisect_right minus one; stop-owning module and A leg transitions distinct from visible labels. Consumed S evidence only from suppressed candidate lineage, after exact larger E stop and strict boundary; bridge retains independent accepted A identity set, resolves exact original owner, replaces continuation, rebuilds canonical audit.

Internal behavior filter currently copies arrays only, obsolete secondary Order arguments unused. Final visibility excludes E at StopAll source, restores referenced S and A lineage, sorts source time/index, filters occupied source index and invalid S. Bridge snapshots prefilter parents for projection, range filters later, retains all calculation-accepted A sources for OrderAudit. Visibility is not calculation owner promotion.

contract.contract: Physical primary grouping uses source index/time only after decision horizon filtering. Role winner and identity source are separately chosen; matching legs require actual confirmed primary point. StopAll ownership removal is horizon-limited. Matching seed uses accepted S/E and StopAll source occupancy, qualification from max decision times; strict crossing begins after event. Bridge supplies finalized native groups and full-history accepted audit.

Native audit resolver selects conceptual owner then opposite physical direction. Primary confirmation gate inclusive; secondary first index gate and confirmation strict, canonical reaction required. Secondary direct selection earliest first/confirmation/break, reset-leg exceptions, and stop strictly after both confirmation and event. Audit cause snapshots copied. Globally earliest primary commitment mutates ledger through bridge callback and invalidates proposals; equal cancellation/stop handled as ambiguous; post-PL3 Orders do not create PL4.

Bullish mirror negates prices and exchanges high/low, preserves time/index, flips crossing direction and labels, maps callback to native low registration. Live retained state requires matching timeframe/datetime and dirty rewind to containing main candle, replaying commits. Reversal prefix independently recalculates strictly before boundary, validates primary3 provenance, advances only at strict interior boundary, caches optionally, releases segment indexes, and offsets new segment output.

First transition selects confirmed number3 by earliest crossing then source index/cycle tie; bridge resolves final labels at market.end_index, retains required accepted Order identities, invokes primary only with configured primary/E/lifecycle and chosen direction (bearish when both). No runtime equality or W2 edge closure inferred.
